alt: A large alligator resting on the edge of a cart path at ChampionGates golf course in Florida, half on the path and half on the fairway grass, with a pond visible in the background
story: Multiple Portugal World Cup players refused to leave their hotel rooms at their FIFA-approved Palm Beach Gardens, Florida training camp after 3–4 alligators were spotted roaming near the practice fields and adjacent lake on June 14, 2026.
why_funny: FIFA approved a World Cup training facility where prehistoric reptiles patrol the grounds — and the world's best footballers are too scared to go to training.
